name: Acolyte
description: You have spent your life in the service of a temple.
feature_description: You and your adventuring companions can receive free healing and care at temples of your faith.

name: Charlatan
description: You have an uncanny knack for getting what you want.
feature_description: You have created a second identity with documentation and acquaintances.

name: Criminal
description: You are an experienced criminal with a network of contacts.
feature_description: You have a reliable contact who acts as your liaison to the criminal underworld.

name: Entertainer
description: You thrive in front of an audience.
feature_description: You can always find a place to perform and receive free lodging and food.

name: Folk Hero
description: You understand the common folk and their struggles.
feature_description: Common folk will hide and shelter you from authorities.

name: Guild Artisan
description: You are a member of a trade guild.
feature_description: You can request lodging and food at guild halls and get access to guild resources.

name: Hermit
description: You lived in seclusion for a formative part of your life.
feature_description: Your seclusion gave you a unique discovery that is key to your adventuring career.

name: Noble
description: You were born into wealth and privilege.
feature_description: You are welcome in high society and people will accommodate you.

name: Outlander
description: You grew up in the wilds, far from civilization.
feature_description: You have an excellent memory for maps and geography, and can find food and water for yourself and up to five others.

name: Sage
description: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse.
feature_description: You can usually recall or find information on any topic if you have access to a library.

name: Sailor
description: You spent time at sea on a ship.
feature_description: You can arrange free passage for yourself and companions on a sailing ship.

name: Soldier
description: You served in an army or militia.
feature_description: You can get access to military compounds and authority among soldiers.

name: Urchin
description: You grew up on the streets of a major city.
feature_description: You can move through cities twice as fast and know secret passages.
